title: genome_annotator pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and should contain only letters, digits, spaces or underscores.

genome.errorMessage: Genome fasta file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', 'fna' or '.fasta' (possibly gzip compressed)

species.description: Scientifc species name (genus and species) or NCBI Taxid
species.help_text: Genus and species can be separated by a '_'. Example: `'Arabidopsis thaliana'`,  `'armadillidium_nasatum'` or `3702`.

gff.description: Current annotation of the genome. Can be a `GFF` or `GTF` file.
gff.errorMessage: Existing annotation GTF file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.gtf', '.gff' or '.gff3'

items.errorMessage: BAM file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

R1.description: Forward fastq file (paired-end) or single fastq file (single-end). Mandatory field.
R1.errorMessage: Forward / single fastq file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension `.fq` or `.fastq` (`gzipped` if possible).

R2.errorMessage: Reverse fastq file cannot contain spaces and must have extension `.fq` or `.fastq` (`gzipped` if possible).

items.description: Forward fastq file (paired-end) or single fastq file (single-end). Mandatory field.
items.errorMessage: Fastq file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension `.fq` or `.fastq` (`gzipped` if possible).

SRA IDs must start with 'SR', 'ER' or 'DR'. For now, only SRA and ENA IDs are supported. If you encounter issues or if your reads come from other databases, please consider using nf-core/fetchngs first.

SRA IDs must start with 'SR', 'ER' or 'DR'. For now, only SRA and ENA IDs are supported. If you encounter issues or if your reads come from other databases, please consider using nf-core/fetchngs first.
Protein Fasta file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', 'faa' or '.fasta' (possibly gzip compressed)

items.help_text: The list of recognised clades can be found at https://data.orthodb.org/current/download/odb_data_dump/odb12v2_levels.tab.gz
A comma separated set of species names to exclude. The list of recognised species can be found at https://data.orthodb.org/v12/download/odb_data_dump/odb12v2_species.tab.gz

database.description: A string containing the name of one of the databases listed in the [mmseqs2 documentation](https://github.com/soedinglab/MMseqs2/wiki#downloading-databases). This database will be downloaded and formatted for eukaryotic genome annotation. Set to `UniRef50` by default.
database.help_text: mmseqs2 lists a large number of databases, not all of which are appropriate for use with MetaEuk. MetaEuk requires protein inputs, so you should select one of the Aminoacid or Profile options.

items.description: GTF file(s) generated by a previous Braker and used to guide TSEBRA annotation. Each GTF file must have extension '.gtf'. When specifying multiple files, the order must be the same as the order of the Braker Hintsfile.
items.errorMessage: Braker GTF file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.gtf'

items.description: Hinstfile(s) file generated by a previous Braker and used to guide TSEBRA annotation. Each Hintsfile must have extension '.hintsfile.gff'. When specifying multiple files, the order must be the same as the order of the Braker GTF files.
items.errorMessage: Braker hints GFF file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.hintsfile.gff'
